male/S0001_ja.mp3.text: 私はサッカーファンです。

female/S0001_ja.mp3.text: 私はサッカーファンです。

male/S0002_ja.mp3.text: 明日の午前中ならお会いすることができます。

male/S0002_en_normal.mp3.text: I can see you tomorrow morning.

male/S0002_en_slow.mp3.text: I can see you tomorrow morning.

male/S0002_en_fast.mp3.text: I can see you tomorrow morning.

male/S0003_ja.mp3.text: あなたはすぐに泳げるようになるでしょう。

male/S0003_en_normal.mp3.text: You will be able to swim soon.

male/S0003_en_slow.mp3.text: You will be able to swim soon.

male/S0003_en_fast.mp3.text: You will be able to swim soon.

male/S0004_ja.mp3.text: 彼女は5歳でバイオリンが弾けた。

male/S0004_en_normal.mp3.text: She could play the violin at five.

male/S0004_en_slow.mp3.text: She could play the violin at five.

male/S0004_en_fast.mp3.text: She could play the violin at five.

male/S0005_ja.mp3.text: チケットがあれば、入場できます。

male/S0005_en_normal.mp3.text: You can enter if you have a ticket.

male/S0005_en_fast.mp3.text: You can enter if you have a ticket.

male/S0006_ja.mp3.text: ここに駐車してはいけません。

male/S0006_en_normal.mp3.text: You can't park your car here.

male/S0006_en_slow.mp3.text: You can't park your car here.

male/S0006_en_fast.mp3.text: You can't park your car here.

male/S0007_ja.mp3.text: ラジオをつけてもいいですか。

male/S0007_en_normal.mp3.text: Can I turn on the radio?

male/S0007_en_slow.mp3.text: Can I turn on the radio?

male/S0007_en_fast.mp3.text: Can I turn on the radio?

male/S0008_ja.mp3.text: 窓を開けてくれませんか？

male/S0009_ja.mp3.text: その本を貸してもらえますか？

male/S0009_en_normal.mp3.text: Could you lend me the book?

male/S0009_en_slow.mp3.text: Could you lend me the book?

male/S0009_en_fast.mp3.text: Could you lend me the book?
